info.title: Aegis HTTP API
info.description: Control Aegis deployments over HTTP. Authenticate with a session (POST /api/v1/auth/login; send X-CSRF-Token on changes) or an API token (Authorization: Bearer). Requests that change state must send `Content-Type: application/json`.

200.description: Whether the GitHub repository can be read without credentials (`ok` false: private, or doesn't exist)
Registered (not deployed); per-app errors and next steps
The folders scans may look in (empty: scanning is off)
Apps found (at most 2 levels deep); nothing is changed

200.description: Signed in; sets the aegis_session cookie

204.description: Changed; all sessions (including this one) are ended

Backups, newest first

404.description: Unknown group or no webhook configured

AccessCheckDto.description: Whether a repository could be read (`git ls-remote`).

branch_found.description: Whether the app's branch exists (when known).

position.description: 1-based place in the deploy order; default: last.

version.description:
The version the operator confirmed (e.g. `v0.2.0`); refused if the
latest known release is a different one.

aegis_version.description: The Aegis version that made it.

path.description: Where the archive is on the server (for `aegis-daemon admin restore`).

problem.description: Set when the archive can't be read (it can still be deleted).

CertStatusDto.description: The certificate state of a domain.

state.description:
"valid", "expiring" (renewal due), "expired", "pending" (being
requested), "error", "disabled" (ACME is off) or "off" (HTTP only).

ChangeSourceRequest.description:
A new source for an existing app: a git repository (`repository_url`,
optional `branch` and `source_subdir`) or a folder on the server
(`source_dir`, optional `source_subdir`). Give exactly one of
`repository_url` and `source_dir`. Validated like registration; takes
effect at the next deployment.

branch.description: Branch to deploy (default: the app's current branch, else main).

source_dir.description: Absolute path of a folder on the server.

source_subdir.description: Build and run only this folder of the source (monorepos).

ConfigPreviewDto.description: The project's aegis.toml with current and proposed settings applied.

base.description:
"source" (the project's directory), "release" (the live release) or
"none" (no aegis.toml yet).

include_releases.description: Include release directories. Defaults to `[backup] include_releases`.

replace.description:
Replace an existing key (it stops working once removed from the
repository). Without it, an existing key makes this a 409.

project_id.description: Reuse an existing project id (e.g. from aegis.toml).

source_dir.description: Directory on the server that deployments copy code from.

source_subdir.description:
Build and run only this folder of the source, e.g. `apps/web` in a
monorepo (relative, no `..`).

scope.description: "read" (GET requests only) or "deploy" (everything except managing tokens and passwords).

all_apps.description: `true` (the default) lets the user see every app.

apps.description:
Names or ids of the only apps the user may see (not for admins).
Apps added later are not included until you add them.

password.description:
At least 12 characters. Give it to the person out of band; they can
change it after signing in.

domains.description:
Domains the built-in proxy no longer serves; they can be mapped
to another app right away.

releases_kept.description: The release directories and logs were kept on disk.

DeployKeyDto.description: A deploy key's public half. The private key is never returned.

add_key_url.description: Where to add the key, for GitHub repositories.

clone_url.description:
The URL deployments clone with this key (GitHub HTTPS URLs are
converted to SSH); `null` when the app's source can't use a key.

public_key.description:
One line, `ssh-ed25519 AAAA... aegis:<app>`: add it to the
repository's deploy keys (read-only).

repository_url.description: Clone this repository instead of the project's default source.

source_dir.description: Copy code from this server directory instead of the project's default source.

strategy.description:
GracefulSwitch (default: the project's setting, else GracefulSwitch),
Immediate, Rolling or BlueGreen. Rolling and BlueGreen need the app
to be served by the built-in proxy.

version.description: Release name; generated from the current time when omitted.

status.description: Queued, InProgress, Success, Failed or RolledBack.

project.description:
A registered app (id or name) whose deploy key is used to clone,
and whose source folder is the default.

repository_url.description: ...a git repository to clone (shallow) for detection.

source_dir.description: A directory on the server, or...

source_subdir.description: Look inside this folder of the source (monorepo apps).

DetectedDto.description: The settings a deployment from this source would use.

oneOf.description:
The package.json start script hard-codes its port: use
`suggested_start` (reads `$PORT`) as the start command, and `port`.

DockerStatusDto.description: Whether container apps (`[run] runtime = "docker"`) can run here.

reason.description: Why Docker can't be used (not installed, daemon not running, no permission).

oneOf.description: Absent while the proxy is disabled.

EnvFileStatusDto.description: An app's env file as the daemon sees it right now.

error.description: Why it can't be used, e.g. permission denied (never contains values).

names.description: Variable names it defines (values are never returned).

readable.description: The file was read and parsed just now.

EnvImportCandidateDto.description: A variable found in the pasted file. Its value is not returned.

exists_as.description: `variable` or `secret` when the app already has this name.

multiline.description: The value spans several lines (only possible as a secret).

EnvImportPreviewRequest.description: The contents of a `.env` file, pasted or read in the browser.

content.description: dotenv text, at most 1 MiB. Never stored or logged.

choices.description: Name -> `variable`, `secret` or `skip`. Names not listed are skipped.

content.description: The same dotenv text as for the preview; parsed again on the server.

restart_required.description: The running process still has the old environment; restart it to apply secrets.

secrets.description: Saved as Secrets (encrypted). A Variable of the same name was removed.

variables.description: Saved as Variables (written into the next release's aegis.toml).

EnvOverviewDto.description:
Names and sources of an app's environment variables. Values are never
included. Precedence, lowest first: env file, `[env]` in aegis.toml,
Variables, Secrets, then `PORT`.

env_file_dirs.description:
Directories env files may be in (`[apps] env_file_dirs`); empty
means env files are turned off on this server.

EnvSourceDto.description: One variable the app gets and where its value comes from.

build.description: Build commands see it (env file, `[env]` and Variables; not Secrets).

overrides.description: Lower-precedence sources that also define it and are overridden.

source.description:
`env_file`, `aegis_toml`, `variable`, `secret`, or `aegis` (`PORT`,
which Aegis sets; an env file's `PORT` is ignored).

code.description: not_found, invalid_argument, failed_precondition, forbidden or internal.

commit.description: Commit to deploy every member at (default: the branch's latest).

only_changed.description:
Deploy only members whose watch paths match files changed since
their live commit (members not deployed yet always deploy). Default true.

GroupDeploymentDto.description: A deployment of a whole group at one commit.

rollback_on_failure.description:
When a member fails, the members already switched in that group
deployment go back to their previous release.

webhook_configured.description: A webhook secret exists for the group.

GroupMemberDto.description: A member app of a group.

commit.description: The commit its live release was built from.

status.description: Its process status (Running, Stopped, ...), when it has one.

watch_paths.description: Repository paths (globs) that concern this app; empty: all of them.

GroupMemberRunDto.description: One member's part in a group deployment.

status.description: pending, deploying, deployed, skipped, failed or rolled_back.

members.description: Members in deploy order (create only; use the members endpoints later).

changed_apps.description: Apps with changes that concern them (or never deployed).

path.description: Payload URL path; prefix it with the API's public base URL.

recent.description: Most recent signed deliveries, newest first.

password.description: At least 12 characters. Needed to see the app again after signing in.

ImportAppRequest.description:
One app to import. Give a `repository_url` (cloned at each deployment)
or a `source_dir` (copied at each deployment).

oneOf.description:
Dashboard settings to save with the app (start command, port, env
file, ...); omitted fields follow aegis.toml and detection.

source_subdir.description: Build and run only this folder of the source (monorepo apps).

apps.description: One entry per requested app, in order. Imported apps are not deployed.

next_steps.description: What to do before the first deployment.

project_id.description: Set when the app was registered.

cpu_cores.description: CPU in use (cores) at the latest sample, while it runs.

memory_bytes.description: Memory in use (bytes) at the latest sample, while it runs.

LastUpdateDto.description: The last update this data directory saw.

allow_unsigned.description:
Installed with `aegis-daemon self-update --allow-unsigned`: the
release signature was not checked.

at.description: RFC 3339: when the new version first started.

signed_by.description: ID of the release key whose signature was verified, when known.

LatestReleaseDto.description: The newest stable release found on GitHub.

url.description: The release page with its notes.

LiveCheckDto.description: What requesting a live URL showed.

error.description: Why there was no answer (connection failed, timeout, TLS error...).

expected.description: The statuses that count as up, e.g. `100-499`.

status.description: HTTP status, when there was an answer.

cert_path.description: PEM certificate chain on the server, for tls = "files".

key_path.description: PEM private key on the server, for tls = "files".

watch_paths.description: Globs such as `frontend_v2/**`; empty or omitted: the whole repository.

version.description:
The release now live; `null` when the app was stopped (it had no
release before) or the rollback failed.

members.description: The full member list, in deploy order.

PointDto.description: A chart point: average and peak over the bucket starting at `at`.

desired.description: "running" or "stopped": what the operator last asked for.

image.description: The image the container runs (docker only).

instance.description: Instance number (1-based) when the app runs several instances.

port.description: The port the process listens on (`PORT`).

runtime.description:
"process" or "docker". For "docker", `pid` is the container's main
process (as seen from the host).

status.description: Running, Backoff, Stopping, Stopped, Exited or Failed.

commit.description:
The commit the live release was built from ("local" for a folder
outside git).

oneOf.description: The group the app is deployed with, if any.

instances.description:
Every instance serving the live release, in instance order (one
entry for single-instance apps). Resource limits apply to each
instance on its own.

oneOf.description: The process serving the live release.

protected.description:
The app is hidden behind a password (and unlocked for you right
now, or you wouldn't see it). Set on the project list and `GET
/projects/{p}`.

settings.description: Settings edited in the dashboard (override aegis.toml).

source_subdir.description: The folder of the source that is built and run (monorepo apps).

oneOf.description: The previous release's instances after a BlueGreen switch.

The latest "new commits" check (`GET /projects/{p}/updates` has the
commit list), once one has run.
The latest measurement, while the app runs (all instances together).

ProjectGroupDto.description: The group an app belongs to.

ProjectSettingsDto.description:
Settings that override aegis.toml for future deployments. Omitted
fields fall back to aegis.toml and runtime detection. An empty
`health_check_url` means "healthy while the process stays up".

drain_timeout_secs.description:
Seconds a stopping release gets to finish in-flight requests and
exit after SIGTERM (0-3600; aegis.toml `[deploy] drain_timeout_secs`,
default 10).

env.description:
Plain environment variables, merged over aegis.toml's `[env]` and
written into each release. Use secrets for sensitive values.

env_file.description:
Absolute path of an env file on the server (dotenv syntax), read at
every build and every process start. It must be inside a directory
listed in the daemon's `[apps] env_file_dirs`. Its values are never
stored; Variables and Secrets override them. Omit (or send `null`)
for none: like every field here, an omitted value is cleared.

health_check_timeout_secs.description:
Seconds a new release may take to become healthy (1-3600; aegis.toml
`[deploy] health_check_timeout_secs`, default 30). Raise it for apps
that start slowly.

instances.description:
Instances to run, 1-16 (more than 1 needs a domain on the built-in
proxy). Takes effect with the next deployment.

strategy.description:
Default deployment strategy: GracefulSwitch, Immediate, Rolling or
BlueGreen (the last two need a domain on the built-in proxy).

verify_expect.description:
Statuses that count as up: `200` or a range like `200-399` (default
`100-499`, anything but a server error).

verify_timeout_secs.description: Seconds the verify URL may take to come up (1-3600, default 30).

verify_url.description:
After the new release is live, request this http:// or https:// URL
(e.g. the public domain). If it isn't up within `verify_timeout_secs`
the deployment is rolled back to the previous release and fails with
the HTTP status or error seen (`[deploy] verify_url`).

upstream_port.description: Local port requests go to right now (the first instance's).

upstream_ports.description: Every instance's port; requests are spread over them.

enabled.description: Whether the built-in proxy runs (`[proxy] enabled`).

source_dirty.description: Built from a server folder that had uncommitted changes.

status.description: Built, Active, Inactive, Failed or Archived.

backend.description:
"cgroup2", "cgroup1", "docker" (a container app's limits, applied by
Docker) or "none".

reason.description: Why limits are unavailable, or partly so.

ResourceLimitsDto.description: Limits for one app; `null` means unlimited.

cpu_cores.description: CPU time in cores (0.5 = half of one core).

memory_bytes.description: Hard memory limit in bytes; the soft limit is 90% of it.

pids_max.description: Maximum number of processes and threads.

version.description: Defaults to the release that was live before the current one.
The release that is now live.

oom_kills.description: Out-of-memory kills in the current process's cgroup.

throttled_ratio.description: Share of CPU periods held back by the CPU limit, 0-1.

ScanCandidateDto.description: An app found by a scan, with the settings an import would use.

deploy_key.description:
`required` (SSH remote), `check` (GitHub over HTTPS: may be
private), `unknown` or `no`.

env_file.description: The app's `.env`, if there is one.

env_file_allowed.description: The `.env` may be used as the Env file (it is in `env_file_dirs`).

env_names.description: Variable names in the `.env` (values are never read out).

port_in_use.description: What listens on the app's port right now.

registered_as.description: The registered app with the same source (skip it).

repo_root.description: The git checkout the app is in.

source_subdir.description: The app's folder inside the checkout (monorepo apps).

ScanInfoDto.description: Whether scanning is on, and where.

env_files_enabled.description: Env files are on (`[apps] env_file_dirs` is set).

path.description: An absolute path inside one of the allowed folders.

skipped.description: Folders not looked into, and why.

truncated.description: The scan stopped at its depth or entry limit.

SecretDto.description: A secret's name and when it last changed. Values are write-only.

created.description: False when an existing secret was replaced.

restart_required.description: The running process still has the old value; restart it to apply.

csrf_token.description: Send as `X-CSRF-Token` on requests that change state (sessions only).

expires_at.description: When the session expires if left idle (unix seconds; sessions only).

SetResourcesRequest.description: New limits. Omitted or `null` fields become unlimited.

force.description:
Apply even if the memory limit is below current use or more memory
is promised to apps than the host has (otherwise 409
`confirmation_required`).

value.description: The value; stored encrypted and never returned.

StandbyDto.description:
The previous release, kept running after a BlueGreen switch so a
rollback to it is instant.

StartHintDto.description: A start script that fixes the app's port, and its `$PORT` form.

suggested_start.description: The proposed start command, e.g. `npx next start -p $PORT`.

position.description: New 1-based place in the deploy order (omitted: unchanged).

blocked_reason.description: Why the available update can't be applied from here.

check_enabled.description: `[update] check`: when false, Aegis makes no update requests.

check_error.description: Why the last check failed (checks are retried later).

mode.description:
How an update is installed here: `in_place` (Aegis replaces its own
binary), `helper` (a root-owned helper service does), `manual` (an
administrator runs `manual_command`) or `unsupported`.

mode_detail.description: What applying means on this machine.

release_keys.description:
IDs of the release signing keys this build verifies releases with.
Empty: this build has no key, so updates can't be installed from the
dashboard (`blocked_reason` says what to do instead).

update_available.description: `latest` is newer than the running version.

UpdateSummaryDto.description: A short form for lists (the Overview).

all_apps.description: `true`: the user sees every app again.

apps.description: Replaces the list of apps the user may see (empty: none).

password.description: New password; signs the user out everywhere.

UpdatesDto.description: How an app's live release compares with its source.

behind.description: Commits after the live one (`null`: unknown).

changed_files.description:
Files changed since the live commit (only those matching the app's
watch paths when it is in a group and has some; at most 500).

deployed.description: The app has a live release.

dirty.description: Folder apps: files with uncommitted changes.

error.description: Why the check couldn't be completed (it never blocks anything).

head.description: The branch head, or the folder's HEAD.

kind.description: "git" (a repository branch) or "folder" (a server folder's git HEAD).

live_commit.description: The commit of the live release.

relevant.description: Some change concerns this app, or it was never deployed.

all_apps.description: True: the user sees every app (always the case for admins).

apps.description: With `all_apps` false, the names of the only apps the user sees.

rollback.description: Roll back to the previous release when the URL isn't up.

url.description: http:// or https:// URL to request; the app's verify URL when omitted.

events.description: Events Aegis acts on ("push"; "ping" is acknowledged).

path.description: Payload URL path; prefix it with the API's public base URL.

secret.description: Shown once. Paste into the GitHub webhook's "Secret" field.

configured.description: A secret exists, so deliveries are accepted.

path.description: Payload URL path; prefix it with the API's public base URL.

recent.description: Most recent signed deliveries, newest first.

repository_url.description: Pushes need a repository to clone.

session.name: aegis_session
session.description: Session cookie from POST /api/v1/auth/login. Requests that change state also need the X-CSRF-Token header.
